selection_path_measurement.verdict: Managed decode/convert/match total ~1% of navigation, now measured rather than assumed. Native enumeration dominates. The 4-12 s navigation delay is NOT fixed; the full region walk per click is structural. See narrower-operation design in the handoff.

results.native_clock_note: SKILL cputime quantizes to 1 s and counts process CPU across threads: every native phase reads an exact multiple of 1000 ms, and enum 5000 was observed with native wall 3758. Per-phase error bars are ~+/-1 s. Sub-second phases read 0 unless their span crosses a quantum boundary.
results.session_trend_note: Same-finding A reads 7.6s, 10.6s, 11.7s, 11.7s across one Allegro session; cold A reads 8.0s. No warm-cache benefit. Per-call SKILL state is reset each call (verified in source); mechanism open.
